genius.licensingRegulator: Astana Financial Services Authority (AFSA); active FinTech Lab Participant license AFSA-A-LA-2025-0013 for Providing Money Services in relation to Digital Assets as issuer of a fiat stablecoin
genius.notes: AFSA lists AnchorX.KZ Limited as an active FinTech Lab Participant authorized for fiat-stablecoin money services. This foreign license does not establish GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, foreign comparability or OCC registration. Issuer materials describe 1:1 CNH redemption and monthly public reserve attestations; service terms limit current services to Professional Investors under the referenced SFO definition. The reserve dashboard expressly aggregates issuance versions from AnchorX.KZ Limited and AnchorX Global Limited and displays a February 22, 2024 snapshot. Disclosure-presence flags do not assert current balances, independent assurance, or reserve sufficiency for either version. Keep the existing KZ issuer attribution without assigning its license to the Global entity. No qualifying public U.S. approval, pending application, foreign registration or issuer-announced GENIUS pathway was located. The linked June 2026 report is publicly previewable by title, but its contents were not recovered in this verification; no monthlyAttestationPresent finding is made.
